verdict.rationale: Trello advertises an MCP server to "Connect Trello to any AI tool" (trello-docs-6), so users can drive Trello through natural language in an external AI client. Its own AI feature is described only as helping write or edit content (trello-docs-32), and due-date parsing from card titles (trello-docs-29) is a narrow natural-language convenience. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of what operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
